name: Carlsbad Plaza South Shopping Center

The center operates daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, providing accessible shopping hours for busy residents and visitors to this popular coastal city. The center's location on El Camino Real offers excellent visibility and easy access for the surrounding Carlsbad community, making it a go-to destination for convenient shopping needs.
